system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform action: Sends OTP for NABARD livestock loan authentication.. my mobile_number is 9876514688, my aadhaar_number is 100020003158.

function.name: nabard_verify_documents
function.description: Initiates document verification for a submitted loan application. Transitions verification_status to 'in_progress'. Required documents include identity proof, land records, and project proposal. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve loan. Fails if application not submitted or documents are incomplete/invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the loan application.

function.name: nabard_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for NABARD livestock loan authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.
